question: For instances in availability zone “flare3”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, and cached network_info JSON (including the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of memory_mb partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), but only return those rows where the instance’s memory_mb is greater than the overall average memory_mb of all instances returned by that same flare3 query. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH flare3_base AS (
  SELECT
    i.uuid,
    i.display_name,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    c.network_info
  FROM instances AS i
  LEFT JOIN instance_info_caches AS c
    ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
),
flare3_windowed AS (
  SELECT
    b.uuid,
    b.display_name,
    b.vm_state,
    b.memory_mb,
    b.network_info,
    AVG(b.memory_mb) OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.vm_state
      ORDER BY b.memory_mb
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS windowed_avg_memory_mb
  FROM flare3_base AS b
),
flare3_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb
  FROM flare3_base
)
SELECT
  w.uuid,
  w.display_name,
  w.vm_state,
  w.memory_mb,
  w.network_info,
  w.windowed_avg_memory_mb
FROM flare3_windowed AS w
CROSS JOIN flare3_avg AS a
WHERE w.memory_mb > a.overall_avg_memory_mb
ORDER BY w.vm_state, w.memory_mb;
